text:
rachel: Quick sync after the postmortem. We're seeing repeated partial responses during multi-AZ failovers. Need a small, actionable canary + client mitigations plan with owners.

priYa: +1. My read: (1) reconnect storms amplify load, (2) servers close streams too aggressively when handshake latency spikes.

tom: I'll take client-side. Plan: prefer resume tokens, implement jittered exponential backoff, and add a hedging opt-in for sampled users.

marc: I'll own server-side degrade mode. Proposal: when node p95 handshake > 1s OR CPU >85%, mark node DEGRADED and keep streams open but tag frames with 'degraded=true'.

infra-bot: [monitor] 2301011142: stream.partial_rate p95=0.82% (threshold 0.5%) in eu-central-1.

rachel: Action items (short):
- C1 tom: SDK resume+backoff + hedging flag (due 2026-04-05)
- C2 marc: degraded-state rollout (metadata-only canary) (due 2026-04-04)
- C3 priya: dashboards + reconnect_spike metric + runbook (due 2026-04-03)
- C4 rachel: coordinate canary window and customer cohort (due 2026-04-02)

tom: SDK pseudo config I'll add:
```
resume_prefer: 3
reconnect:
  max_attempts: 5
  base_ms: 200
  jitter: 0.25
hedge_sample_pct: 1
```

marc: On server: add 'degrade_reason' string on stream frames and ensure resume tokens are honored even in DEGRADED mode (don't close stream early).

priya: Dashboards: reconnect_rate, partial_rate_by_az, resume_success_rate, degraded_streams_count. Runbook for oncall: check reconnect_spike -> if degraded nodes visible toggle routing fallback -> escalate infra.

rachel: Canary plan: enable metadata-only degraded flag in one AZ for 24h, measure partial_rate and resume_success. If partials drop >30% for the cohort, promote to circuit-breaker behavior.

tom: I'll start a branch and tag PR with incident-canary.

marc: I'll push the metadata-only change behind a feature flag and schedule a canary deploy tonight 01:00 UTC.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] 2301011160: canary scheduled cluster-canary-5 at 2026-03-25T01:00:00Z.

rachel: Weekly follow-up: owners update status by next Friday with simple status: blocked / in-progress / done and a 1-line note. If blockers appear, DM me. :thumbsup:
